en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a Baroque-style church with a tall clock tower and onion-shaped spire. The church has high arched windows and ivy growing along its lower walls. Surrounding it are multi‑storey townhouses with shops on the ground floors. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled square. Shop signs in German are visible on the left and right buildings.
